page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7i.32xlarge is an x86_64 bare-metal compute-optimized instance equipped with dedicated hardware acceleration, running on KVM virtualization. The configuration provides 128 dedicated vCPUs paired with 768 GB of system memory, establishing an allocation of 6 GB of RAM per core. Parallel compute workloads are accelerated by four integrated NVIDIA A10 GPUs, delivering an aggregate total of 96 GB of GDDR6 VRAM across the four 24 GB devices.

Network infrastructure for the instance features a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-speed data transfer across cluster environments and rapid dataset retrieval. The configuration does not bundle local disk storage, necessitating network-attached storage volumes for operational file systems and persistent storage. In addition, no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned directly to the instance.

Resource consolidation across 128 dedicated cores and four enterprise-grade GPUs enables dense processing capabilities within a single host envelope. Qualitatively, grouping four accelerators on one physical machine mitigates inter-node network bottlenecks common to distributed multi-node architectures. The hardware profile of the ecs.ebmgn7i.32xlarge is aligned with workloads such as deep learning model inference, video encoding and decoding pipelines, graphical rendering, and compute-intensive scientific processing.

It is suited for parallelized machine learning inference, visual computing, video transcoding, and compute-heavy scientific simulations.
